messages:
noah: Heads up — for the last 20m we've seen intermittent packet drops and high tail egress on a subset of eu-west hosts. impact: 2 dedicated pools showed >30% request retries and a spike in preemptions.

anya: Any obvious network partition or vendor maintenance?

noah: Not in the cloud status. stack traces show repeated TCP retransmits between proxy and slot-manager. sample log:
```
[2026-07-03T03:04:12Z] slot-manager: host=eu-west-2a-047 tx_retries=412 rx_drops=97 egress_bytes=1.3GB/min
[2026-07-03T03:04:13Z] allocator: preempt tenant=fastbot slice=0.25 reason=egress_congestion
```

devon: Could be noisy-tenant egress hogging the NIC. We already have per-tenant shaping but that is token-bucket at host-level, not per-slice. When fractional dedicated tenants burst they bypass soft-fairshare.

pat: If NIC is saturating, spilling to warm pool increases cross-host traffic which worsens packet loss. We should consider a local circuit-breaker that temporarily clamps egress for bursting tenants and forces their fallback to quantized variants rather than remote warm-pool.

anya: Agreed. Proposal: add host-local egress-circuit with two levers: 1) soft-clamp per-slice (drops new connections / 429 to client) and 2) aggressive fallback routing to local quantized models when clamp trips. Also expose a per-tenant knob so enterprise customers can opt-out.

noah: Good. We need to be careful about QoS: dropping at host will increase client retries and cost. Better to return a structured response indicating "degraded-mode" with latency hint. That way SDKs can degrade gracefully.

devon: Implementation sketch:
```
if host.nic_util > 85% and tenant.egress_rate > slice_threshold:
  clamp_duration = min(30s, tenant.sla_burst_window)
  route.request -> local-quantized
  emit metric host.egress_clamp{tenant}
```

pat: Cost note: local-quantized reduces egress but may raise token inference CPU time. tradeoff is cheaper than cross-host retransmit. we should simulate with replay logs for eu-west-2a.

anya: Ops rollout: canary across 5 hosts in eu-west-2a for 6h, watch metrics: host.pkt_retransmits, allocator.preempt_count, tenant.sla_violations. Also add alert when clamp_rate > 1/min.

noah: Who owns SDK change to surface degraded-mode? @devx? pinging internal-but we can ship server-side first and fallback to simple 429+body if SDK not ready.

infra-bot: experiment created by devon: egress-circuit-breaker v1 -> canary(eu-west-2a 5 hosts, 6h) monitors=[host.pkt_retransmits, host.nic_util, allocator.preempt_count, metric:host.egress_clamp].

pat: I'll run a log-replay sim with last 7 days of bursts and estimate p99 latency delta + cross-host bytes saved. will post results in this thread.

noah: Great. tagging @oncall to watch 03:00-06:00 UTC tomorrow. keep it loud if anything odd. :ear:
